'''TAY-0''' was a conceited,<ref name="Episode Guide" /> refurbished [[Czerka Arms|Czerka]] [[CM3-series protocol droid]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and [[racer]] [[droid]] who piloted a modified [[12-series speeder|12 series speeder]] [[repulsorcraft]] and participated in the celerity sport of [[Riot Racing]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Serolonis]]<ref name="Episode Guide" /> between [[19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> He was bet to win a race for the [[information broker]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback]], against her old associate [[Grini Millegi]], with [[Jet Venim]], the reigning champion of the [[Safa Toma Classic]], as his racer.<ref name="Faster" />

To witness the race, Scaleback brought two [[Genetically defective clone|defective]] [[clone trooper]]s from [[Clone Force 99]], to be her [[bodyguard]]s. [[Wrecker]] and [[Tech]], who brought the [[Youngling|young]] female [[Cloning|clone]] [[Omega]] with them. During the foremost race, Millegi ordered Venim and the racer [[Kane]] to trap TAY-0's [[speeder]] in "the crunch", that sent his ship hurdling, destroying him. The clones retrieved his [[Limb|pieces]] and rebuilt him for a new race with the stakes heightened, but after repudiating Tech's personal strategy of racing he was annihilated by [[Bosco Brix]]'s speeder and powered down for the final time. Tech participated in TAY-0's place and used his tactics to win the race, and Scaleback's arrears were laid off.<ref name="Faster" />

==Biography==
===Worthy of a bet===
{{Quote|You are doing it wrong, human. Calculations won't help you. It is all about strategy and skill, of which you have zero.|Tay-0, to Tech|<ref name="Faster" />}}
TAY-0 was a [[droid]] [[racer]] of the [[Safa Toma Classic]] by the time of the [[Imperial Era]]<ref name="Faster" /> between [[19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> He participated in [[Riot Racing|Riot Races]] for hundreds of fans with his modified [[12-series speeder|12 series speeder]] [[repulsorcraft]] in the [[Safa Toma Speedway]] of [[Serolonis]]. TAY-0 opted for offense over all, with the policy of almost no rules he equipped his [[speeder]] with [[blaster cannon]]s to destroy any competition. The [[Trandoshan]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback]] began betting [[currency]] on TAY-0 against the [[Dowutin]] [[Grini Millegi]] and his racer, [[Jet Venim]], the reigning champion of the Safa Toma Classic.<ref name="Faster" />

Between 19 BBY and 18 BBY, Scaleback came to Serolonis to witness the race for her earnings with two other employee's from [[Clone Force 99]] to act as [[bodyguard]]s, [[Tech]] and [[Wrecker]] who brought the adolescent [[Cloning|clone]] [[Omega]] for supervision. Once they had arrived at the Safa Toma Speedway, Scaleback explained to Omega the concept of Riot Racing as they watched from a balcony the [[Nikto]] racer [[Bosco Brix|Bosco "The Mad Bomber" Brix]] shoot down a [[Seven Duece Blaster]] [[speeder]] being piloted by the droid racer [[Rod (droid)|"Hyper" Rod]], with TAY-0 instantaneously gaining the lead over them. He pushed past Brix and became the victor the race. Shortly thereafter, TAY-0 and Scaleback's crew had a poor first impression, at his [[DUM-series pit droid|pit droid]] station where TAY-0 did little more than gloat his ascendancy in racing over Tech.<ref name="Faster" />

Following then, TAY-0 was operating on his speeder, and asked the clones and Scaleback to gawk at his artwork, before Millegi and Venim made themselves known with a [[Gamorrean]] and the Trandoshan [[Garnac]] behind them as bodyguards. Millegi confronted Scaleback about the upcoming race, glaring at TAY-0 to his displeasure until Millegi stated Scaleback's droid would never beat his [[Nosaurian]]. Millegi stated they would see who had the better racer.<ref name="Faster" />

===Caught in "the crunch"===
TAY-0 then participated in a race unrelated to the bet, with Scaleback's crew watching on the right sidelines. TAY-0 was in the lead with Venim, the both of them approaching [[Gambler's Gulch]], as the audience shifted their view to the [[viewscreen]]'s. Scaleback ordered TAY-0 through a [[comlink]] not to take the corroded [[left tunnel]] out of the available three, to which TAY-0 responded saying he knew what he was doing, and took the center tunnel. From his quarters, Millegi ordered through his own comlink to [[Kane|"Steel Claw" Kane]] to trap TAY-0 in "the crunch". Kane swerved directly behind TAY-0, with Venim in front, and directed a claw to come out of his speeder and attach to TAY-0's speeder engine. Venim made a [[Circular saw|buzz saw]] start to spin and extend from the back of his speeder, and it began slicing into TAY-0's ship to his panic. TAY-0's ship crashed right behind the finish line and TAY-0 was launched out of his speeder and broke into [[Limb|bits]] upon hitting the ground, with Venim winning the race.<ref name="Faster" />

Scaleback and her crew arrived to the field to salvage TAY-0 and his repulsorcraft while Wrecker began collecting the pieces of TAY-0. Omega suggested they could repair him, until Millegi and his associates arrived to collect the payment. Omega interrupted with a rebuttal, offered for one more race, with Millegi winning double the money if he wins, and them earning Scaleback if they win. After some consideration, Millegi agreed, giving them until tomorrow, him keeping Scaleback with his crew until their victory.<ref name="Faster" />

Back in TAY-0's quarters, the clones worked on repairing TAY-0 and his speeder. Tech brought TAY-0 back to consciousness, immediately stating how capable he was of racing, until noticing he was only a torso. As Tech attempted to reattached TAY-0's right arm, TAY-0 felt Tech was connecting the [[servomotor]] incorrectly, and insisted Tech listen to his instructions. Wrecker stated they should take Millegi out, to Tech's denial. TAY-0 told them the last sponsor who were inferior to expectations is now in hiding. Tech complained on how this was not the first time Scaleback had gotten herself into trouble, but TAY-0 told them to complete him and stop talking what was nonsense to him.<ref name="Faster" />

===A Tech-nicality===
After TAY-0 was repaired, he told Wrecker he would not lose again, and wondered why Tech was viewing a race TAY-0 was missing from. He noticed Tech was studying the track layout, and trotted back to his quarters, stating that calculations would not help him, but strategy and skill. Tech told him that his strategy was wrong, and to subvert more power to the shields than weapons. TAY-0 stopped in place and laughed, and was about to tell Tech about his policy on offensive measures, before a speeder crashed into him, driven by Brix. Millegi and his group arrived with Scaleback, in time to witness TAY-0 powering down once and for all, saying that he regretted nothing.<ref name="Faster" />

With TAY-0 gone, Tech engaged in the race, falling to last place in the first lap purposefully, to let the attacks from Venim and other top players take out the weak targets. When he reached Gambler's Gulch, he used the center tunnel before asking Omega to transmit the schematics of the left tunnel to his display. He came under fire by [[Haxxon Trajanix|Haxxon "The War Gnome" Trajanix]], using his overheating shields to distribute energy from weapons to them. Reaching the end of the tunnel to the view of the spectators, he dislocated the weapons from the speeder to expedite it. Omega and Tech realized that the left tunnel was dilapidated, with a chasm in the floor, but Tech knew with enough speed he could cross it. Brix followed Tech into the tunnel, but while Tech persevered Brix fell. When Tech made it past the Gulch, Venim and Kane enclosed Tech to attempt to use "the crunch," but Tech dodged the grasp of the claw and made it grab onto Venim's ship and take both racers down. Emerging from the dust of his enemies, Tech won the race, and Scaleback's freedom.<ref name="Faster" />

==Characteristics==
TAY-0 was an extremely haughty and supercilious droid when it came to racing, always assuring his success and the strategy he used to attain it. He prioritized offensive measures over all in the dangerous conditions of the Safa Toma Classic, general strategy and skill were what he believed in, as he saw the proficiency in himself. He was diligent in shutting down any contradictions to his scheme, stating calculations were irrelevant.<ref name="Faster" />

==Equipment==
TAY-0 stood slightly taller than Tech,<ref name="Faster" /> who was 1.93 [[meter]]s tall.<ref name="CWCE JtB">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]''</ref>

TAY-0 resembled a [[humanoid]], with two arms and legs on either side of him, and five-fingered hands. TAY-0's head had three [[Color|teal]] [[photoreceptor]]'s in the locations of the points of a triangle, with a speaking mechanism under them. His head had the ability of spinning 360 degrees to see behind himself without having to turn his body around.<ref name="Faster" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|TAY-O has arrived on The Bad Batch! I LOVE VOICING DROIDS!!!|Ben Schwartz|<ref name="Ben TAY-O">{{Twitter|rejectedjokes|status/1615793460682067968|[[Ben Schwartz]]|quote=TAY-O has arrived on The Bad Batch! I LOVE VOICING DROIDS!!!|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/njsbY}}</ref>}}
TAY-0 first appeared in the episode "[[Faster]],"<ref name="Faster" /> the fourth episode of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'s'' [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]], which premiered on [[January 18]], [[2023]].<ref name="Airdate">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}}</ref>

The character was the second droid in [[Star Wars]] voiced by [[Ben Schwartz]], having done voice work on the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]] along with [[Bill Hader]] in the first installment of the Star Wars [[Sequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens]], being the first appearance of the [[BB-series astromech droid|BB-unit]]. As well, Schwartz had played a [[First Order]] [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] in the film.<ref>{{Twitter|rejectedjokes|status/992470518149275649|Ben Schwartz|quote=On this beautiful #MayThe4thBeWithYou I feel like I can finally reveal that I played a Storm Trooper in @starwars The Force Awakens. It was an incredible honor and years later, I'm still smiling from the experience but please do not tell BB8.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/ecAMP}}</ref>
